recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source fix is needed for FHIR-39795; any future cleanup of the unreferenced legacy value set file should be handled separately as repository hygiene rather than as a required semantic correction for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-39795 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested changing BodyStructure.includedStructure.bodyLandmarkOrientation.distanceFromLandmark.device from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(Device), binding the coded side the same as Device.type, renaming distanceFromLandmark.measurementDevice to distanceFromLandmark.value, and updating the new value short display.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied through PR #2594 and links commit eee115d, a merge update on that branch. The actual BodyStructure source change was c08a723cf9, which changed .device to CodeableReference(Device), switched the binding to DeviceType/http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-type, and renamed .measurementDevice to .value. Follow-up commit 86a1883099 refined the value short display to 'Measured distance from body landmark.'
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists bodystructure=BodyStructure and notes that BodySite became BodyStructure, so source/bodystructure/structuredefinition-BodyStructure.xml is the current build-scope source for this artifact. OO WGM minutes for 2023-01-16/20 explicitly considered DeviceDefinition and answered 'Do we need to reference deviceDefinition? - no,' supporting the current Device-only target. FHIR-39796 later refined adjacent distance unit wording and is already represented on the combined branch. A legacy BodyStructure-specific value set source file remains, but it is unreferenced by the StructureDefinition and fhir.ini, build.fhir.org returns 404 for its old page, and the current device-type value set lists the BodyStructure element use. Zulip searches found no issue-specific conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current BodyStructure StructureDefinition already defines distanceFromLandmark.device as CodeableReference targeting Device with the DeviceType/device-type binding, and defines distanceFromLandmark.value with the measured-distance wording. The remaining short-display wording difference is a harmless follow-up refinement consistent with the approved meaning and later same-element unit-flexibility work.
